Madhya Pradesh Revives State Bus Network with 351 New Buses

Madhya Pradesh has revived its state-run public bus network, launching 351 new buses as part of new schemes. The flagging off ceremony was attended by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and Chief Minister Mohan Yadav. This revival marks the return of organized public bus transport in the state after the Madhya Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (MPSRTC) was shut down in 2005 due to losses and debt.
